messages.subject: Loading Deducer's functions in RStudio
parts:
Hi All,

I regularly teach R programming using RStudio because its installation is very error free compared to JGR's. I would like to teach Deducer's frequencies and descriptive.table functions, but when I load Deducer in RStudio it generates error messages since RStuio does not support winMenuAddItem. Is there a way to load Deducer's functions and not it's GUI?

Thanks,
Bob

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Loading Deducer's functions in RStudio
parts:
Deducer should load fine from the command line if winMenuAdd does not exist, otherwise it assumes that it is in the windows GUI and ads menu items accordingly. I was unaware that R-Studio defined winMenuAdd, but not winMenuAddItem. Anyhow you can alway load Deducer with no gui functionality, which can be useful for reproducing your analyses outside the Deducer GUI.

options(DeducerNoGui=TRUE)
library(Deducer)

messages.subject: Re: Loading Deducer's functions in RStudio
parts:
options(DeducerNoGui=TRUE)

For general reference of anyone finding this thread, I have found that capitalization is important. I need to run:
options(DeducerNoGUI=TRUE)
to not have the errors. Note that GUI is all capitals. With "DeducerNoGui", I still have the errors.
